children: Spanish industrial prices rose 13.2% in the 12 months through August following a 9.4% increase in the 12 months through July, the National Statistics Institute (INE) said on Thursday.
August's increase was the largest since December 2022, when it hit 14.9%, INE data showed. The rise was mainly driven by higher oil refining and gas prices.
INE revised up the July figure from an initial 9.2% increase. Month-on-month, industrial prices rose 2.9% in August from July, INE said.
Companies tend to pass on industrial price rises to customers, ultimately fuelling inflation.

Spain's European Union-harmonised 12-month inflation rate, a main measure of price increases nationally designed to be comparable across EU member states, rose to 4.6% in August, up from 3.9% in the period through July.
